subject: Marketplace product page — final launch readiness & private offer SKUs
messages:
From: Carla Perez <carla@acmeai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace product page — final launch readiness & private offer SKUs

Hi Alex / Kimberly / Naomi,

Thanks for the sync earlier — attaching the product brief and the latest procurement notes. We're aiming for an AWS Marketplace go-live in the first week of November. Two asks from our side to make that timeline realistic:

1) Can you review the draft product page copy and confirm hero bullets that map to our co-sell talking points? We need copy that sales can easily recite for AWS field pitches.

2) We need a Private Offer SKU mapping for our current pricing tiers (trial / standard / enterprise). Procurement wants to see exact SKU ids and invoice flow before they sign.

I've attached: acme_product_brief.pdf and a short procurement summary. If you can send a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with dates by EOD Friday that would help our internal approvals.

Also flagging two security asks from legal: SOC 2 evidence and an SSO integration note. Kimberly, I believe you already have a SaaS security sheet?

Best,
Carla
Carla Perez
Head of Partnerships, Acme AI
Carla Perez | Acme AI

Attachments: acme_product_brief.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Carla Perez <carla@acmeai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page — final launch readiness & private offer SKUs

Carla — thanks for the brief and the clear asks. Quick responses below and a proposed MAP attached.

- Draft copy: we're sending a first pass of listing copy (draft_listing_copy_v1.docx). I focused the hero on predictable inference cost, regional availability, and the co-sell benefits (field demo kit + enablement). Please call out any field objections we should preempt.

- SKUs / Private Offer: attached is sku_mapping_v3.csv. It's a draft mapping of our meter/sku combos to Acme tiers. Once you confirm pricing bands we'll lock the private offer artifact.

- Timeline: MAP proposes the following milestones — copy approval by Tue 10/19, SKU/PO final by Thu 10/21, AWS preview handshake on Fri 10/22, production listing target Mon 11/1. We can compress if Acme legal accelerates.

- Security evidence: Kimberly, can you attach the SaaS security sheet (SOC 2 pointers + SSO notes)? Carla, we will include a short evidence bundle the marketplace team accepts.

I've included two preview links in the MAP and a sample sales blurb for co-sell intro. If this looks good, can Acme procurement confirm the billing entity and PO workflow?

Thanks — I'll stand up a shared demo tile for the field and schedule the AWS preview slot once the copy is approved.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
 alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: draft_listing_copy_v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB), sku_mapping_v3.csv (CSV, 8KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Carla Perez <carla@acmeai.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page — final launch readiness & private offer SKUs

Carla / Alex — attaching our security evidence template (SaaS-Security-Sheet.xlsx) and a short redline of the draft listing copy. High-level notes below:

- Hero bullets: please tighten the first bullet to reference single-tenant data isolation when used via Private deployment; otherwise we risk overselling Hosted features.

- Claims: the draft references "near real-time inference at 30ms" — unless Acme wants to call out a specific benchmark, let's soften to "low-latency inference" and link to our benchmark page. Precision claims require an evidence footnote.

- Trial wording: procurement requested that trial entitlement clarify duration and whether tokens are counted against usage quotas. Suggest we add a single line under the trial CTA.

- SKU mapping: procurement@acmeai.com — confirm billing entity (Acme AI, Inc.) and whether the enterprise tier will use reserved capacity (Dedicated) or standard hosted metering. That affects SKU selection.

I'll make the copy redlines inline in draft_listing_copy_v1.docx and push v2 by EOD.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace product page — final launch readiness & private offer SKUs

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick summary and confirmation from Redwood: 

- Copy: Alex / Kimberly's redlines accepted. Alex, please publish draft_listing_copy_v2.docx to the preview link and I'll walk the ACME field on Monday.

- SKUs / PO: procurement@acmeai.com confirmed the billing entity as "Acme AI, Inc." and prefers the enterprise tier to be a Private Offer with reserved Dedicated capacity. Carla, your PO docs look good — please send the signed private_offer_PO-ACME.docx back to procurement and cc us so we can coordinate listing activation.

- Security: Kimberly, your SaaS sheet covers the SOC 2 notes we need. We'll attach the evidence bundle to the marketplace evidence slot.

Next steps:
- Alex to upload draft_listing_copy_v2.docx and updated sku_mapping_v3.csv to the AWS preview by EOD Mon 10/18.
- Acme to return signed PO by Thu 10/21.
- AWS preview handshake Fri 10/22; final go/no-go for launch on Mon 11/1.

I'll schedule the preview check with the AWS marketplace team once uploads are complete. Thanks — excited to get this live.

Naomi Feldman
Marketplace Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
